name: Little Ram Oyster Co.
description: A woman-owned oyster farm growing in Gardiners Bay off Long Island's North Fork. Oysters are sold directly from a self-serve farmstand on weekends, and the farm takes bookings to get people out on the water to see how the bay is worked and to shuck a few. Seasonal preorders run around the holidays.

name: Peconic Gold Oysters
description: A Cutchogue farm growing oysters by hand in the Great Peconic Bay and selling them from a self-serve roadside stand on County Road 48, where a bag of two dozen sits alongside shucking knives and payment works on the honour system. The farm runs two size lines, a smaller classic and a larger one when available, and also sells through an online store. It carries NYS Grown & Certified and a Slow Food East End Snail of Approval.
